involved_tools.name: generate_bar_chart
involved_tools.description: Generate a horizontal bar chart to show data for numerical comparisons among different categories, such as, comparing categorical data and for horizontal comparisons.

data.description: Data for bar chart, such as, [{ category: '分类一', value: 10 }, { category: '分类二', value: 20 }], when grouping or stacking is needed for bar, the data should contain a `group` field, such as, when [{ category: '北京', value: 825, group: '油车' }, { category: '北京', value: 1000, group: '电车' }].

group.description: Whether grouping is enabled. When enabled, bar charts require a 'group' field in the data. When `group` is true, `stack` should be false.

stack.description: Whether stacking is enabled. When enabled, bar charts require a 'group' field in the data. When `stack` is true, `group` should be false.

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the chart, such as, '#fff'.

palette.description: Color palette for the chart, it is a collection of colors.

texture.description: Set the texture for the chart, optional, default is 'default'. 'rough' refers to hand-drawn style.

style.description: Style configuration for the chart with a JSON object, optional.

theme.description: Set the theme for the chart, optional, default is 'default'.

width.description: Set the width of chart, default is 600.

height.description: Set the height of chart, default is 400.

axisXTitle.description: Set the x-axis title of chart.

axisYTitle.description: Set the y-axis title of chart.

labelFormatter.description: Set the label formatter for chart using d3-format syntax: [[fill]align][sign][symbol][0][width][,][.precision][~][type]. Fill: padding character, default is space. Align: '<' left align, '^' center, '>' right align, '=' number right align. Sign: '+' always show sign, '-' show negative sign only, '(' negative in parentheses. Symbol: '#' base prefix, '$' currency symbol. 0: zero padding. Width: minimum width. ,: thousands separator. Precision: precision control. ~: trim trailing zeros. Type: format type. Common types: 'd' integer (42), 'f' fixed decimals (42.00), 'e' scientific notation (4.2e+1), 's' SI prefix (42k, 1.5M), '%' percentage (42%), '$' currency ($42.00), 'r' significant digits (42.0), 'g' general (42). Examples: '.2f' fixed 2 decimals (23.45), '.0f' integer (23), '.1%' percentage (23.4%), ',.0f' thousands separator (1,234,567), 's' SI prefix (1.2M, 3.4k), '.1s' 1 decimal SI (1.2M, 3.4k), '~s' trimmed SI (1.2M, 3k), '.0s' integer SI (1M, 3k), '$,.2f' currency ($1,234.56), '$.2s' currency SI ($1.23M), '.2e' scientific (1.23e+6), '.2g' general (1.2e+6 or 1234), 'd' decimal (1234), 'x' hexadecimal (4d2), 'o' octal (2322), 'b' binary (10011010010).

y.description: Axis configuration for the chart y-axis, optional.

axis.description: Axis configuration for the chart with a JSON object, optional.

Align: '<' left align, '^' center, '>' right align, '=' number right align. Sign: '+' always show sign, '-' show negative sign only, '(' negative in parentheses. Symbol: '#' base prefix, '$' currency symbol. 0: zero padding. Width: minimum width. ,: thousands separator. Precision: precision control. ~: trim trailing zeros. Type: format type. involved_tools.name: generate_plantuml_diagram
involved_tools.description: Generate a PlantUML diagram with automatic syntax validation and error reporting for auto-fix workflows. Returns embeddable image URLs for valid diagrams or structured error details for invalid syntax that can be automatically corrected. Optionally saves the diagram to a local file.

plantuml_code.description: PlantUML diagram code. Will be automatically validated for syntax errors before generating the diagram URL.

output_path.description: Optional. Path to save diagram locally. Automatically creates all necessary parent directories. Restricted to current working directory by default. Set PLANTUML_ALLOWED_DIRS env var (colon-separated paths, or "*" for unrestricted) to allow additional directories. Only .svg and .png extensions permitted.

diagram_name.description: Optional. Base filename to use when output_path is omitted or refers to a directory-like path. The selected format extension is applied automatically.

validate_syntax.description: Optional. Whether to validate PlantUML syntax before generating the diagram. Defaults to true.

return_markdown_embed.description: Optional. Whether to include markdown_embed in successful responses. Defaults to true.

image_alt_text.description: Optional. Custom alt text to use in markdown_embed. Defaults to "PlantUML Diagram".

fetch_timeout_ms.description: Optional. Timeout in milliseconds for PlantUML server requests. Defaults to 30000.

plantuml_server_url.description: Optional. Override the PlantUML server base URL for this request only. Defaults to the server configuration or the built-in public PlantUML endpoint.

skip_fetch_check.description: Optional. Whether to skip the diagram URL fetch check after generation. Defaults to false.

output_mode.description: Optional. Controls response payload shape: full includes url and optional markdown embed, url_only includes url only, markdown_only includes markdown embed only.

involved_tools.name: batch_generate_plantuml_diagrams
involved_tools.description: Generate multiple PlantUML diagrams in a single call. Each entry can have its own code, format, and optional output path. Returns per-diagram results including URLs, markdown embeds, and any validation errors.

id.description: Optional identifier for this diagram entry, returned in the result for correlation.

output_path.description: Optional local file path to save this diagram.

diagram_name.description: Optional base filename used when output_path is a directory-like path.

validate_syntax.description: Whether to validate syntax before generating.

return_markdown_embed.description: Whether to include markdown_embed in each successful result.
